At the start of the turn, all of your leaders with <Ski Mask> in their name gain 2 defense.

S2E1.stext_desc: The defense of the Lowest-Defense Enemy Leader is decreased by 6.

S2E2.name: Linguine (Rotini Colony Super Elite Warrior)

abilities.desc: When this Linguine kills an enemy leader, all remaining enemy leaders are inflicted with [Horrified].
(Once per game) When this Linguine drops below half health, it and every ally leader with <Rotini> in their name gain 8 attack.

S2E2.stext_desc: The defense of the Highest-Attack Enemy Leader is decreased by 5.

S2E2.name: Linguine (Rotini Colony Sailor)

abilities.desc: At the start of the turn, this Linguine gains 8 health. If an ally leader has <Rotini> in their name, it gains 16 instead.
(Once per game) When this Linguine is attacked, the attacker is inflicted with [Dizzy].

S2E2.stext_desc: The health of your Lowest-Health Leader is increased by 6.

S2E2.name: Linguine (Rotini Colony Elite Warrior)

abilities.desc: When this Linguine attacks a leader with [Bleeding], the attack deals 15 more damage.
At the start of the turn, if an ally leader has <Rotini> in their name, this Linguine gains 3 defense.

S2E2.stext_desc: The defense of the Lowest-Defense Enemy Leader is decreased by 6.

S2E2.name: Linguine With A Green Scarf

abilities.desc: At the start of turn 2, if you didn't draw any supporters last turn, your ally leaders are inflicted with [Blessed].
When you draw a supporter, this Linguine's health is decreased by 10.

S2E2.stext_desc: The defense of the Highest-Attack Enemy Leader is increased by 6.

S2E2.name: Linguine (Star Eyes)

abilities.desc: When this Linguine attacks, it inflicts [Lucky] on the enemy leader.
When any leader with <Eyes> in their name attacks, this Linguine gains 3 health.

S2E2.stext_desc: The speed of the Slowest Leader is decreased by 25.

When this Linguine is attacked, it gains 6 health, then this Linguine's defense is increased by 1.

S2E22.stext_desc: The defense of the Highest-Defense Enemy Leader is increased by 6.
S2E22.supporter2_desc: All of your leaders with <Stacked> in their name draw 2 supporters.

S2E22.name: Linguine With An Eye Scarf (Blood Of Creation Absorbed)

abilities.desc: For the first 3 turns, this Linguine can’t be [Stunned], [Paralyzed], [Tired] or [Dizzy].
Attacking all enemy leaders has a 1-turn cooldown. While it cools down, this Linguine attacks the Highest-Health enemy leader instead.
At the start of the first turn, this Linguine is inflicted with [Soul Protected], and every ally leader with <Stacked> in their name gains 15 health.
When any leader dies, this Linguine gains 10 health and 2 attack.

S2E22.name: Linguine (10 Stacked)

abilities.desc: At the start of the turn, draw 1 supporter for every ally leader alive.
When this Linguine is attacked, it gains 3 health for every ally leader alive.

S2E22.stext_desc: The speed of the Slowest Enemy Leader is increased by 50.
S2E22.supporter2_desc: All of your leaders with <Stacked> in their name draw 1 supporter.

S2E22.name: Linguine With An Orange Straw Hat

abilities.desc: When this Linguine attacks, it inflicts [On Fire] on the enemy leader.
When this Linguine is inflicted with [On Fire], its attack is increased by 5.

S2E22.stext_desc: The health of your Slowest Leader is decreased by 6.

S2E22.name: Linguine With A Red Tie

abilities.desc: When this Linguine attacks, it inflicts [Bleeding] on the enemy leader.
When this Linguine is inflicted with [Bleeding], its attack is increased by 5.

S2E22.stext_desc: The health of the Highest-Health Leader is decreased by 4.

S2E22.name: Linguine With A Gold Chain

abilities.desc: When this linguine is killed, add 20 Health to all remaining ally leaders.
When this Linguine attacks, it gains 10 Speed.

S2E22.stext_desc: The health of the Highest-Health Enemy Leader is increased by 6.

S2E22.name: Linguine With A Dark Blue Ski Mask

abilities.desc: When this Linguine attacks a [Frozen] leader, the attack deals 10 more damage.
When this Linguine is attacked, it gains 2 defense.

S2E22.stext_desc: The defense of your Highest-Health Leader is increased by 4.
